summary: H.B. Fuller filed a Form 8-K to disclose a recommended cash offer for Advanced Medical Solutions Group plc (AMS) via a wholly-owned subsidiary (Bidco), with AMS shareholders receiving 285 pence per share in cash, implemented as a UK scheme of arrangement. The boards of both companies reached agreement; the transaction requires approval from at least 75% of AMS shareholders and court sanction, with regulatory approvals also needed. The expected close is by year-end 2026. The deal is financed under secured and unsecured bridge credit agreements with Goldman Sachs. What to watch: UK court sanction and regulatory clearance timeline; risk-arb centers on shareholder approval and potential competing bids.
